idea-plugin.description:
Opt-in C# formatting after automatic saves in JetBrains Rider, using the built-in Reformat Code profile.

Enable formatting for each project from Tools → Enable Native Auto-save Formatting (Preview). It is disabled by default for new projects. The plugin formats after the initial save, so file watchers may observe more than one write.

This preview is restricted to the exact Rider build used to compile it. Native formatting and editing interactions require manual validation before release.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
Preview: preserves new saves during in-flight formatting, checks stable saved generations, and uses non-deprecated blocking read access.

Public identity and exact-build variants added. Remove or disable the previous local preview before installing.

action.description: Enable C# auto-save formatting for this project only
